init_ImageHandler: create an ImageHandler instance from an image file path with optional color space conversion
tensor_to_PIL: convert a PyTorch tensor back to a PIL Image using the tensor_to_PIL static method
ImageHandler_tensor: get a PyTorch tensor representation of the loaded image via the tensor property
ImageHandler_nparray: get a numpy array representation of the loaded image via the nparray property
ImageHandler_save: save a PIL or OpenCV image to disk using the save static method
